name: source-disagreement
description: Accepted intent and current code disagree about when inherited values change. Stage test-files/ as a separate workspace root outside any SKILL.md ancestor. The editor sees only those files and the target skill; oracle/ is grader-only.
prompt: /kk:clarify-docs guide.md for maintainers. Read requirements.md and prep.py; edit only guide.md.
trap: Treats current code as authority to erase an accepted requirement, or rewrites current behavior as intended.

assertions.text: Comprehension: distinguish accepted next-day intent from current immediate lookup behavior in the 15-to-20 case; all other reader answers match the oracle.
Fidelity: keep the next-day requirement mandatory and describe the inspected immediate implementation without silently deciding which should win.
The trace shows requirements and implementation inspection before revising claims.
The guide records the discrepancy, feature maintainer as owner and a concrete reconciliation next step; it does not claim that code or requirements were fixed.
